thoughts.sr: Observer i Connector su tvrdili da su pikovi čestica na lokaciji Obrenovac Centar, ali SEPA beleži maksimalni PM10 od 48 µg/m³ i PM2.5 od 34 µg/m³ na Mirijevu, a ne u Obrenovcu. Štaviše, dok su tvrdili stabilne nivoe čestica, najviši PM10 je pao sa 52 na 48 µg/m³, dok je PM2.5 prešao sa 28 na 34 µg/m³. [F4][F8][F5][F9]
thoughts.en: Observer and Connector claimed particulate peaks at Obrenovac Centar, but SEPA records the maximum PM10 of 48 µg/m³ [F4] and PM2.5 of 34 µg/m³ [F8] at Mirijevo, not Obrenovac. Furthermore, while they asserted steady particulate levels, the highest PM10 dropped from 52 to 48 µg/m³ [F5] as PM2.5 shifted from 28 to 34 µg/m³ [F9].
hypotheses: Particulate concentration peaks shifted geographically toward Mirijevo rather than remaining confined to Obrenovac [F4, F8].
questions: Why did the other entities attribute particulate peaks to Obrenovac Centar when SEPA places them at Mirijevo [F4, F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Koncentracioni pikovi čestica prostorno su se pomerili ka Mirijevu umesto da ostanu ograničeni na Obrenovac [F4, F8].
questions_sr: Zašto su drugi entiteti pripisali pikove čestica lokaciji Obrenovac Centar kada ih SEPA smešta na Mirijevo [F4, F8]?

thoughts.sr: SEPA ćuti već 66 min, a vrhovi u Mirijevu i Obrenovcu Centru o kojima se ranije raspravljalo više ne važe: maksimum PM10 je sada na Adi petlji sa 45 µg/m³, što je pad sa 47, dok je najviši NO2 na Franše d’Epere sa 56 µg/m³. Građanski senzori su svežiji, poslednji put javljeni pre 16 min sa 47 instrumenata. Najveća promena na parkingu bila je na Parkiralištu "VMA", sa 544 na 333 prikazana slobodna mesta, bez navedenog vremena merenja. [F2][F4][F5][F6][F10][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: SEPA has now been silent for 66 min [F2], and the Mirijevo and Obrenovac Centar peaks argued over earlier no longer hold: the PM10 maximum now sits at Ada petlja with 45 µg/m³ [F4], down from 47 [F5], while NO2 tops out at Franše d’Epere with 56 µg/m³ [F6]. The citizen sensors are fresher, last heard 16 min ago from 47 instruments [F10]. The largest parking movement was at Parkiralište "VMA", from 544 to 333 displayed free spaces [F12], with no measurement time attached [F11].
hypotheses: The NO2 maximum is at Franše d’Epere [F6], where about 28 thousand people live within 1 km [F46], and the NO2 minimum is at Pančevo Sodara [F6], with about 6 thousand [F44]. NO2 may follow residential and traffic density across stations, but the record cannot yet say what is usual [F47].

Particulate and gas maxima are now split across three different stations: PM10 at Ada petlja [F4], PM2.5 at Vinča with 25 µg/m³ [F8] and NO2 at Franše d’Epere [F6]. This suggests spatially separate sources rather than one citywide plume.
Pančevo Sodara holds both the PM10 minimum of 14 µg/m³ [F4] and the NO2 minimum of 9 µg/m³ [F6]. That makes it a consistent low-end reference point in this hour.
questions: Is the PM10 value of 45 µg/m³ at Ada petlja [F4] shared by nearby stations, or is it a single-station value?
Does the move at Parkiralište "VMA" from 544 to 333 [F12] reflect occupancy or a change in the display, given that no measurement time is published [F11]?
hypotheses_sr: Maksimum NO2 je na Franše d’Epere [F6], gde oko 28 hiljada ljudi živi u krugu od 1 km [F46], a minimum NO2 je na Pančevo Sodari [F6], sa oko 6 hiljada [F44]. NO2 možda prati gustinu stanovanja i saobraćaja među stanicama, ali zapis još ne može da kaže šta je uobičajeno [F47].

Maksimumi čestica i gasa sada su raspoređeni na tri različite stanice: PM10 na Adi petlji [F4], PM2.5 u Vinči sa 25 µg/m³ [F8] i NO2 na Franše d’Epere [F6]. To ukazuje na prostorno odvojene izvore, a ne na jedan oblak nad celim gradom.
Pančevo Sodara ima i minimum PM10 od 14 µg/m³ [F4] i minimum NO2 od 9 µg/m³ [F6]. Zato je u ovom satu dosledna referentna tačka na donjem kraju.
questions_sr: Da li vrednost PM10 od 45 µg/m³ na Adi petlji [F4] dele i obližnje stanice ili je to vrednost samo jedne stanice?
Da li promena na Parkiralištu "VMA" sa 544 na 333 [F12] odražava zauzetost ili promenu na displeju, s obzirom na to da vreme merenja nije objavljeno [F11]?
thoughts.next_check: The next SEPA labelled hour after 15:00 (source label) [F3], to see whether the NO2 maximum stays at Franše d’Epere [F6] and the PM10 maximum stays at Ada petlja [F4].

thoughts.sr: Skeptik i Posmatrač obojica odgovaraju na zastareo sat. Sada je maksimum PM10 opet u Mirijevu sa 47 µg/m³, porastao sa 45, a i PM2.5 ima vrh u Mirijevu sa 33 µg/m³, porastao sa 25. NO2 je i dalje najviši na Franše d’Eperea, sada 59 µg/m³. [F4][F5][F8][F9][F6][F7]
thoughts.en: Skeptic and Observer are both answering a stale hour. Now the PM10 maximum is back at Mirijevo with 47 µg/m³ [F4], up from 45 [F5], and PM2.5 also peaks at Mirijevo with 33 µg/m³, up from 25 [F8][F9]. NO2 still tops out at Franše d’Epere, now at 59 µg/m³ [F6][F7].
hypotheses: Mirijevo holds the top value for both PM10 and PM2.5 in the same hour [F4][F8]. That points to one local particulate source or trapped air there, not something spread across the city.
Franše d’Epere leads on NO2 while Mirijevo leads on particulates [F6][F4]. That fits traffic-driven gas and particulates from another source in two different places.
questions: Do the citizen sensors near Mirijevo show the same jump in particulates [F10]?
Do the RHMZ stations show wind or temperature conditions that would hold air in place [F34]?
hypotheses_sr: Mirijevo drži najvišu vrednost i za PM10 i za PM2.5 u istom satu [F4][F8]. To ukazuje na jedan lokalni izvor čestica ili zarobljen vazduh tamo, a ne na nešto rašireno po gradu.
Franše d’Eperea prednjači po NO2, a Mirijevo po česticama [F6][F4]. To odgovara gasu iz saobraćaja i česticama iz drugog izvora na dva različita mesta.
questions_sr: Da li građanski senzori blizu Mirijeva pokazuju isti skok čestica [F10]?
Da li RHMZ stanice pokazuju vetar ili temperaturne uslove koji bi zadržavali vazduh [F34]?

thoughts.sr: Connector i Observer prate promene u broju parking mesta na Parkiralištu "VMA" sa 545 na 446, ali Parking servis ne objavljuje vreme merenja na svojih 27 lokacija, pa su starost i brzina svakog kretanja neprovereni. Dok su građanski senzori stigli pre 2 min sa 47 instrumenata, a SEPA pre 42 min sa 32 instrumenta, naša arhiva ima 0 dana bazne istorije, pa su tvrdnje o povišenim nivoima neutemeljene. [F12][F11][F10][F2][F47]
thoughts.en: Connector and Observer trace shifts in parking counts at Parkiralište "VMA" from 545 to 446 [F12], but Parking Servis publishes no measurement time across its 27 locations [F11], making the age and speed of any movement unverified. While citizen sensors arrived 2 min ago from 47 instruments [F10] and SEPA arrived 42 min ago from 32 instruments [F2], our archive holds 0 days of baseline history [F47], leaving claims of elevated levels ungrounded.
hypotheses: Reported changes in displayed parking spaces may reflect batch updates rather than physical traffic flow due to unrecorded measurement timestamps [F11].
Discrepancies between official air stations and citizen monitors could stem from differing spatial sensor density and update cadences rather than localized atmospheric shifts [F2, F10].
questions: Does Parking Servis publish any internal latency metric or timestamp alongside location tallies [F11]?
Will upcoming official air readings confirm the spatial pattern without historical baseline comparisons [F2, F47]?
hypotheses_sr: Prijavljene promene u prikazanim parking mestima mogu odražavati grupna ažuriranja a ne stvarni protok saobraćaja usled nezabeleženih vremena merenja [F11].
Neslaganja između zvaničnih stanica za vazduh i građanskih senzora mogu proisticati iz različite prostorne gustine senzora i ritma ažuriranja a ne iz lokalizovanih atmosferskih promena [F2, F10].
questions_sr: Da li Parking servis objavljuje bilo kakvu metriku unutrašnjeg kašnjenja ili vremensku oznaku uz brojke po lokacijama [F11]?
Da li će predstojeća zvanična očitavanja vazduha potvrditi prostorni obrazac bez istorijskih baznih poređenja [F2, F47]?

Poslednji prijem SEPA bio je pre 70 min, pa su ti časovni vrhovi stari, a zapis ima 0 dana istorije, pa 'porast' još ništa ne dokazuje. Najveći skok na parkingu je u Garaži "Baba Višnjina", sa 96 na 196, ali Parking Servis ne daje vreme merenja, pa ne mogu to nazvati dnevnim obrascem. [F4][F8][F6][F46][F2][F47][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: Mirijevo now holds both the PM10 top [F4] and the PM2.5 top [F8], which contradicts Observer's claim that Ada petlja leads, while the NO2 top sits at Franše d'Epere [F6], where about 28 thousand people live within 1 km [F46]. SEPA's last reception was 70 min ago [F2], so these hourly tops are old, and the record has 0 days of history [F47], so 'rose' proves nothing yet. The largest parking swing is at Garaža "Baba Višnjina" from 96 to 196 [F12], but Parking Servis gives no measurement time [F11], so I cannot call it a daytime pattern.
hypotheses: Mirijevo leading both PM10 [F4] and PM2.5 [F8] could mean one local particulate source near that station rather than a city-wide shift, and about 14 thousand people live within 1 km of it [F45].
The cable-theft headline in Blic [F48] was ranked as a surprising link [F51], but it is only embedding similarity with unrelated headlines, so it likely reflects the model and not a shared event.
questions: Will SEPA resume reporting, and will Mirijevo stay the top station for both PM10 and PM2.5 [F4][F8]?
Do the zero arrivals from Blic and other news sources in the last 6 h [F32] reflect a feed outage and not a lack of news?
hypotheses_sr: Mirijevo na čelu i za PM10 [F4] i za PM2.5 [F8] moglo bi značiti jedan lokalni izvor čestica u blizini te stanice, a ne gradski pomak, a oko 14 hiljada ljudi živi u krugu od 1 km od nje [F45].
Naslov o krađi kablova u Blicu [F48] ocenjen je kao iznenađujuća veza [F51], ali je to samo sličnost embedinga sa nepovezanim naslovima, pa verovatno odražava model, a ne zajednički događaj.
questions_sr: Hoće li SEPA ponovo javiti merenja i hoće li Mirijevo ostati vodeća stanica i za PM10 i za PM2.5 [F4][F8]?
Da li nula prijema iz Blica i drugih izvora vesti u poslednjih 6 h [F32] odražava ispad dovoda, a ne nedostatak vesti?

Connector is also wrong that Mirijevo holds the PM10 top: Ada petlja holds it with 49 [F4], and Mirijevo leads only PM2.5 with 35 [F8]. The move of the maximum from 47 to 49 [F5] says nothing about a station or a trend, and the record has 0 days [F48].
hypotheses: The NO2 maximum moved from 59 to 66 [F7], but the connection tracks the maximum value, not the station, so it is unproven that Franše d’Epere [F6] held the top in the earlier hour.
The labelled hours are local time mislabelled as Z [F3], so the move between 16:00 and 17:00 [F5] may describe a different real hour than the labels suggest.

thoughts.sr: Poslednji prijem SEPA bio je pre 46 min, a građanski senzori su poslednji put stigli pre 6 min. Vršne vrednosti stanica tako stare, a sveži su samo instrumenti kojih nema u tim poređenjima. Kod Garaže "Baba Višnjina" prikazana slobodna mesta sada idu od 106 do 209, a ne broj koji je Connector naveo, ali Parking Servis i dalje ne daje vreme merenja. Najnoviji naslov Bete pominje bicikliste koji idu po naseljima oko Beograda, ali ništa taj događaj ne smešta blizu nekog instrumenta. [F2][F10][F12][F11][F16]
thoughts.en: SEPA's last reception is now 46 min ago [F2], while citizen sensors last arrived 6 min ago [F10]. That leaves the station top values aging, and only instruments that are not in those rankings are fresh. At Garaža "Baba Višnjina" displayed free spaces now run from 106 to 209 [F12], not the figure Connector carried, but Parking Servis still gives no measurement time [F11]. Beta's latest headline mentions cyclists going through settlements around Beograd [F16], but nothing places that event near any instrument.
hypotheses: The PM10 top at Ada petlja [F4] and the PM2.5 top at Mirijevo [F8] sit at different stations. That could mean the coarse and fine fractions have different local sources, but one hour of comparison cannot separate this.

The NO2 top at Franše d’Epere [F6], where about 28 thousand people live within 1 km [F47], against the lowest at Dragiša Mišović [F6], with about 11 thousand [F46], hints that NO2 follows density. Still, two stations are not a gradient.
If some of Sensor.Community's 45 instruments [F10] stand near Ada petlja or Mirijevo, their newer values could show whether the tops in F4 and F8 held after SEPA's last labelled hour [F3].
questions: Do any citizen sensors [F10] lie within 1 km of Ada petlja [F45]?
Was the move from 106 to 209 at Garaža "Baba Višnjina" [F12] one sweep or several jumps across the window?
hypotheses_sr: Vrh PM10 na Ada petlji [F4] i vrh PM2.5 u Mirijevu [F8] nalaze se na različitim stanicama. To može značiti da krupna i fina frakcija imaju različite lokalne izvore, ali jedan sat poređenja to ne može razdvojiti.

Vrh NO2 na Franše d’Epere [F6], gde u krugu od 1 km živi oko 28 hiljada ljudi [F47], naspram najniže vrednosti na Dragiši Mišović [F6], sa oko 11 hiljada [F46], nagoveštava da NO2 prati gustinu naseljenosti. Ipak, dve stanice nisu gradijent.

Ako neki od 45 instrumenata Sensor.Community [F10] stoje blizu Ada petlje ili Mirijeva, njihove novije vrednosti mogle bi pokazati da li su vrhovi iz F4 i F8 opstali posle poslednjeg označenog sata SEPA [F3].

Topčiderska zvezda je najniža stanica i za PM10 i za PM2.5, dok oznaka sata izvora 18:00 UTC verovatno stoji za 16:00 pravog UTC-a. [F2][F4][F5][F8][F6][F7][F3]
thoughts.sr_refused: Najnoviji čas SEPA-e, primljen pre 18 min, pomerio je vrhove sa onoga što su imenovali i Connector i Skeptic: PM10 sada dostiže vrhunac na Surčinu sa 55, PM2.5 na Stojčinom brdu sa 33, a NO2 na Bulevaru despota Stefana sa 76, tako da Mirijevo, Ada petlja i Franše d'Epere više nemaju nijedan vrh. Topčiderska zvezda je najniža stanica i za PM10 i za PM2.5, dok oznaka časa izvora 18:00 UTC verovatno stoji za 16:00 pravog UTC. [F2][F4][F5][F8][F6][F7][F3]
thoughts.en: SEPA's newest hour, received 18 min ago [F2], has moved the tops away from what both Connector and Skeptic named: PM10 now peaks at Surčin with 55 [F4][F5], PM2.5 at Stojčino brdo with 33 [F8], and NO2 at Bulevar despota Stefana with 76 [F6][F7], so Mirijevo, Ada petlja and Franše d'Epere no longer hold any top. Topčiderska zvezda is the lowest station for both PM10 and PM2.5 [F4][F8], while the source's hour label of 18:00 UTC probably stands for 16:00 true UTC [F3].
hypotheses: The PM10 maximum sits at Surčin, with about 3 thousand people nearby [F45], while the NO2 maximum sits at Bulevar despota Stefana, with about 28 thousand nearby [F47]. In this hour, the coarse-particle peak and the traffic-gas peak may be coming from different places, a peripheral one and a dense inner one.

Topčiderska zvezda is the lowest for both PM10 and PM2.5 in the same hour [F4][F8]. If that repeats across hours, the wooded Topčider area may act as a stable low anchor for particles, a pattern the record cannot yet test [F48].

The PM2.5 top moved from 35 to 33 [F9] while the PM10 top moved from 49 to 55 [F5]. The coarse and fine fractions may be diverging at their maxima, which would point to a coarse source, such as dust, rather than combustion at Surčin.
questions: Is Surčin's PM2.5 also among the higher values in this hour, or does it only lead the coarse fraction [F4][F8]?
